_doc: Prompt template for AI-generated props. {placeholders} come from the asset's 'vars' in config/assets.json.
prompt: Stylised-realism 3D game prop: {object}. Materials: {materials}. Clean simplified shapes, real-world proportions, plain unbranded surfaces, game-ready, even lighting, isolated object
negative: logo, text, letters, numbers, brand, emblem, sponsor, watermark, person, base, pedestal, ground plane
